## Guide 2. How to Configure General Settings
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000019742
Welcome to the General Settings video for Brilliant Directories' Quick Start Setup Guide.
This video will guide you through all of the major features and options within the General Settings of the Brilliant Directories platform. We recommend watching this video first.
Some of the topics discussed in this video are:
Setting Up General Settings
Setting Up "Staging Mode"
Uploading Your Logo & Favicon
Adding Company Email
Adding Google Analytics
